name: – Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela – Before § 1 – Am 4
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: -1b. Regrets, therefore, the cuts, over the course of successive multiannual financial frameworks, in the allocations earmarked for social, economic and territorial cohesion; urges that these allocations be increased in the 2027 budget;
